home.stepsTitle: From idea to running on its own.
home.step1Desc: Browse the existing collection, or request a custom build for your workflow.
home.step2Desc: Discuss needs, scope, and pricing directly with the team at @kryptoncodes.
home.step3Desc: Your tool is configured until it truly runs — complete with a usage guide.
home.step4Desc: The automation keeps working in the background; you just watch the results.
home.faq1Q: How do I buy or order a tool?
home.faq1A: Everything happens on Telegram via @kryptoncodes. Pick a product from the catalog, open its details, then continue in chat — the team replies fast.
home.faq2Q: Can I request a custom tool?
home.faq2A: Absolutely. Describe the workflow you want automated; we'll help define the scope, the estimate, and build it.
home.faq3A: A shared endpoint for AI models (OpenAI-API compatible). Generate a personal key via @kryptoncode_bot with /genapi, then use it in your apps.
home.faq4Q: Is there a guarantee and support?
home.faq4A: Every tool is tested until it runs in your environment, with a usage guide included. If anything breaks, support is available in the community group.
home.ctaTitle: Got an idea? Let's automate it.
home.ctaDesc: Start with a casual chat — tell us what you need and we'll point you to the most efficient path.
